gaps: trip page that gathers time, weather, currency and a packing list
verse_extra: the destination's local time, forecast, currency and country facts by asking
ride and food deep links once you land (skills/rides.js)
first_page: Trip page /trip/ for someone planning a journey. First: "flights to paris" opens a page with the search handed to Google Flights, Kayak and Skyscanner as prefilled links (no scraping), beside what Verse already knows: local time, a 10-day forecast, currency at a typed rate, distance, and a packing checklist kept on the device, all in one link. Will not build: fare search, price tracking or booking (no keyless fare source, and money stays out).
